proposals.before: An Chonghui, Privy Council commissioner, was made acting Grand Preceptor and Left Leading Infantry General while keeping the Privy Council post.
proposals.after: An Chonghui, Privy Council commissioner, was made acting Minister of Works and Left Leading Infantry General while keeping the Privy Council post.
proposals.reason: Chinese 檢校司空 is acting Minister of Works (Sikong), not Grand Preceptor (太師).

proposals.before: Privy Council commissioner An Chonghui was made acting Grand Preceptor, held as Left Leading Infantry General, and continued as before as Privy Council commissioner.
proposals.after: Privy Council commissioner An Chonghui was made acting Minister of Works, held as Left Leading Infantry General, and continued as before as Privy Council commissioner.
proposals.reason: Chinese 檢校司空 is Sikong (Minister of Works), mistranslated as Grand Preceptor.

proposals.before: On yimao Bohai's King Da Yinse sent tribute envoys.
proposals.after: On yimao Bohai's King Da Yinzhuan sent tribute envoys.
proposals.reason: 大諲譔 is Da Yinzhuan, not Da Yinse.

proposals.before: That month Zhang Xian, Beiping deputy commissioner, was executed for losing his post.
proposals.after: That month Zhang Xian, Northern Capital deputy commissioner, was executed for losing his post.
proposals.reason: 北京 here is the Northern Capital (Taiyuan), not Beiping.

proposals.before: On wuchen, Golden-Glitter Grand Master of Splendid Culture and acting Grand Preceptor Zhao Zaili was made Huazhou military commissioner and acting Grand Guardian.
proposals.after: On wuchen, Golden-Glitter Grand Master of Splendid Culture and acting Minister of Works Zhao Zaili was made Huazhou military commissioner and acting Grand Guardian.
proposals.reason: 檢校司空 is Minister of Works, not Grand Preceptor.

proposals.before: On renwu, former Yunzhou prefect Zhang Wen was made Zhenwu acting military commissioner; left-and-right wing assault-array commanders Kang Yicheng and Suo Zitong were made Fenzhou and Xinzhou prefects.
proposals.after: On renwu, former Weizhou prefect Zhang Wen was made Zhenwu acting military commissioner; left-and-right wing assault-array commander Kang Yicheng was made Fenzhou prefect; left-and-right wing cavalry commander Suo Zitong was made Xinzhou prefect.
proposals.reason: 蔚州 is Weizhou not Yunzhou; Kang and Suo held distinct prior offices and separate prefectures.

proposals.before: Li Congke, Hedong acting commissioner, became Hedong commissioner; the court congratulated him.
proposals.after: Li Congke, Hezhong acting commissioner, became Hezhong commissioner; the court congratulated him.
proposals.reason: 河中 is Hezhong, not Hedong (河東).

proposals.before: Lu Zhi, Hanlin edict-drafter and War minister, became acting grand preceptor and Tong commissioner.
proposals.after: Lu Zhi, Hanlin edict-drafter and War minister, became acting Minister of Works and Tong commissioner.
proposals.reason: 檢校司空 is Minister of Works, not grand preceptor.

proposals.before: Kong Xun, acting Bian prefect, reported that the mutinous commanders led by Zhao Xu—three thousand men and below—had been wiped out to the clan.
proposals.after: Kong Xun, acting Bian prefect, reported that the mutinous commanders led by Zhao Qian—three thousand men and below—had been wiped out to the clan.
proposals.reason: 趙虔 is Zhao Qian, not Zhao Xu.

proposals.before: On dingmao Wang Yan of false Shu—acting Works minister, gate councilor, co-equal councilor, and Duke of Jin—became acting Works minister and Ling prefect; Shi Tan of Guo became Yao training commissioner.
proposals.after: On dingmao Wang Xie of false Shu—acting Works minister, gate councilor, co-equal councilor, and Duke of Jin—became acting Works minister and Ling prefect; Shi Tan of Guo became Yao training commissioner.
proposals.reason: 王諧 is Wang Xie; Yan confuses him with 王衍.

proposals.before: Yang Bin, Minister of Personnel of the false Shu, was made Supervising Secretary, appointed Academician of the Hall for Collecting Worthies, and placed in acting charge of the institute.
proposals.after: Yang Bin, Minister of Personnel of the false Shu, was made Drafting Attendant, appointed Academician of the Hall for Collecting Worthies, and placed in acting charge of the institute.
proposals.reason: 給事中 matches Drafting Attendant in the prior sentence, not Supervising Secretary.

proposals.before: One ran the Three Bureaus and handed affairs to Yuan Sui;
proposals.after: One ran the Three Bureaus and handed affairs to original retainers;
proposals.reason: 元隨 means original retainers or followers, not a personal name Yuan Sui.

proposals.before: One held the Three Bureaus and entrusted affairs to Yuan Sui;
proposals.after: One held the Three Bureaus and entrusted affairs to original retainers;
proposals.reason: 元隨 means original retainers or followers, not a personal name Yuan Sui.

proposals.before: On jimao, Revenue Bureau director and edict drafter Yang Ningshi was made Drafting Attendant, charged as History Office reviser and acting director;
proposals.after: On jimao, Bureau of Review director and edict drafter Yang Ningshi was made Drafting Attendant, charged as History Office reviser and acting director;
proposals.reason: 比部郎中 is Bureau of Review director, not Revenue Bureau director.

proposals.before: Doulu Sheng, Tongzhou Changchun Palace aide, Court Gentleman for Prolonging Grace, acting Director of the Secretariat, Director in the Ministry of Rites, and recipient of the purple-gold fish bag, and Wei Tao, Preparation Gentleman, acting Outer-Section Director of the Ministry of Revenue Bureau of State Farms, Academician of the Chongwen Hall, and recipient of the scarlet fish bag, had each relied on power and influence to enter official ranks suddenly. They had no talents or achievements worth commending, yet had long stolen favor and honor.
proposals.after: Dou Lu Sheng, Tongzhou Changchun Palace aide, Court Gentleman for Prolonging Grace, acting Director of the Secretariat, Director in the Ministry of Rites, and recipient of the purple-gold fish bag, and Wei Tao, Preparation Gentleman, acting Outer-Section Director of the Ministry of Revenue Bureau of State Farms, Academician of the Chongwen Hall, and recipient of the scarlet fish bag, had each relied on power and influence to enter official ranks suddenly. They had no talents or achievements worth commending, yet had long stolen favor and honor.
proposals.reason: Compound surname 豆盧 should be Dou Lu to match Dou Lu Ge, not fused Doulu.

decisions.reason: Chinese 檢校司空 is the acting Sikong (Minister of Works); 太師 would be Grand Preceptor. The proposed replacement matches the title.
Literal likewise misreads 檢校司空 as Grand Preceptor; Minister of Works is the correct office.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以樞密使安重誨為檢校司空

decisions.reason: 大諲譔 romanizes as Da Yinzhuan; Da Yinse invents a different given name.
In this Later Tang annal 北京 is the Northern Capital (Taiyuan), not Beiping; the replacement restores the place title.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 北京副留守、知留守事張憲

decisions.reason: Zhao Zaili's held title is 檢校司空 (acting Minister of Works), not Grand Preceptor.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 金紫光祿大夫、檢校司空趙在禮

decisions.reason: Chinese has 蔚州 (Weizhou), not Yunzhou, and assigns Kang and Suo distinct prior offices and separate prefectures; the proposed literal restores that structure.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以前蔚州刺史張溫為振武留後，以左右廂突陣指揮使康義誠為汾州刺史，以左右廂馬軍都指揮使索自通為忻州刺史

decisions.reason: 河中 is Hezhong; Hedong would be 河東. The replacement corrects the circuit name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 河中留後從珂為河中節度使

decisions.reason: Lu Zhi was made 檢校司空, acting Minister of Works, not grand preceptor.
The rebel commander is 趙虔 (Zhao Qian); Zhao Xu does not match the graph 虔.
王諧 is Wang Xie; Wang Yan confuses him with Former Shu’s 王衍.
Yang Bin receives 給事中, the same office rendered Drafting Attendant for Yang Ningshi in the preceding unit; Supervising Secretary breaks that consistency.
元隨 is the common noun for original retainers, not a personal name Yuan Sui.
Literal likewise invents Yuan Sui from 元隨; original retainers is the correct reading.
比部郎中 is director of the Bureau of Review, not the Revenue Bureau.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 比部郎中、知制誥楊凝式

decisions.reason: 豆盧 is the compound surname Dou Lu; fused Doulu mismatches the chapter’s Dou Lu Ge spelling.
